info.name: TestMu AI SmartUI API Documentation Autoheal Command Logs Get Build Status API
Fetch build status by buildId or buildName

params.name: projectToken
params.description: Validate and map the project in which the build exists

params.name: buildId
params.description: Unique ID for the build. You can get it from the URL of build's tests page.

params.name: buildName
params.description: Name of the build. (For storybook project, provide build ID)

items.docs: This API fetches the build status along with the count of different screenshot statuses. **Note:** When both `buildId` and `buildName` are provided in the request, `buildId` will be given priority over `buildName`.
